jobs.occupation: Technical Project Lead (f/m/d) Footwear– Milwaukee® (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Job Description: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in
cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our
focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial,
construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement,
repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes
MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® - recognized worldwide for their deep
heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality. The
company maintains a global manufacturing and product development
footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2
billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people
is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across
all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of
being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed
decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing
superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our
winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth. To
strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart area) as soon as possible,
we are looking for a Technical Project Lead (f/m/d) Footwear–
Milwaukee® Your responsibilities: Lead and develop NPD projects in
EMEA in accordance with our development process on all technical
aspects for design and development Responsible for the completion of
assigned engineering projects within budgetary and scheduling
guidelines Lead tradeoff discussions and conversations around risk
management with cross-functional teams Drive design of project to meet
market driven design guides and fulfill cost, timing, reliability, and
manufacturing requirements Analyze, evaluate and select from design
execution alternatives to best meet specification objectives and
implement designs into mass production Accountable for technical
elements of project execution including integration of complicated
components and assemblies, material selection, packaging and safety,
regulatory and standards compliance Conduct design and safety reviews
as needed to gain necessary approvals for product development phase
progressions Schedules, develops agendas, facilitates and documents
project meetings, tracks project schedules to ensure adherence to
timelines Regularly makes presentations of project status Your
profile: Bachelor's degree or further technical education, preferably
in Mechanical Engineering or a related field Relevant experience in
project management and product development Understanding of technical
processes in engineering like product development and technical
documentation Ideally relevant professional practice in safety
footwear industry Good command of English, a European language is an
advantage Advanced knowledge in MS Office application Extensive
Knowledge in CAD systems Willingness to travel as required for
business (approx. 30 %) Your perks: An interesting position with an
attractive company – recognized as a "top employer” by kununu 30
days of annual leave, home office opportunities, and trust-based
working hours Free parking spaces directly next to the office and good
public transport connections Fresh fruit, water and hot beverages for
free Company fitness via "EGYM Wellpass” EAP (mental support for
employees) Learning platforms such as "GoodHabitz” and "Learn TTI”
for your professional development Special employee benefits via
"Family & Friends” and additional corporate benefit Are you
interested? If you like wild growth and working with happy,
enthusiastic over-achievers, you will enjoy your career with us! Send
your application stating your earliest possible starting date and your
salary expectations directly via our careers page . Naturally, we will
treat your application with the utmost discretion. We look forward to
getting to know you! Techtronic Industries ELC GmbH Human Resources
– Agnese Cesarini · Max-Eyth-Straße 10 · 71364 Winnenden
www.ttigroup.com/careers/global-career-opportunities

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking a proactive,
detail-oriented and experienced Senior HR Manager (m/f/d) to join our
team in Berlin. This role will be responsible for leading key people,
compliance, and governance activities across the employee lifecycle,
ensuring that HR practices are legally compliant, operationally
effective, and aligned with organisational objectives. Acting as a
trusted advisor to managers and employees, the role provides expert
guidance on employment and employee relations matters, oversees HR
compliance and audit readiness, and drives continuous improvement of
HR policies and processes. The role also leads Health, Safety &
Environment (HSE) initiatives, ensuring compliance with German and
European regulations while promoting a safe, healthy, and engaging
workplace. Working closely with internal stakeholders, external
partners, and legal advisors, the Senior HR Manager identifies and
mitigates people-related risks, maintains strong governance
frameworks, and contributes to a positive employee experience across
the organisation. This position is ideal for an experienced HR
professional who enjoys combining hands-on operational work with
compliance oversight and strategic enhancement of HR practices. Key
Responsibilities Employment & Employee Relations Support managers on
employment-related matters and people management practices. Draft and
review employment contracts, amendments, and employment documentation.
Ensure compliance with German labor law and collective agreements
where applicable. Manage employee relations cases, including
disciplinary procedures, grievances, performance-related matters, and
workplace concerns. Partner with external legal advisors when
required. Compliance, Audits & Risk Management Conduct regular
internal HR audits to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and
company requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.
Identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions. Support
external audits and inspections related to employment, payroll, HR
processes, and workplace regulations. Monitor and communicate changes
in employment legislation and HR compliance requirements. EU Health,
Safety & Environment Lead and coordinate health and safety initiatives
in accordance with German and European regulations. Ensure compliance
with occupational health and safety requirements. Partner with
internal stakeholders and external providers to maintain safe working
environments. Coordinate risk assessments, workplace inspections, and
mandatory training. Support wellbeing initiatives that promote
employee health and engagement. Policies, Governance & Process
Improvement Review, maintain and develop HR policies, procedures, and
employee handbook content. Ensure policies are legally compliant,
practical, and consistently applied across the organization. Drive
continuous improvement initiatives across HR operations and employee
experience. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human
Resources, Business Administration, Law, Psychology, or a related
field. 5+ years of progressive HR experience in a generalist or HR
operations-focused role. Strong knowledge of German labour law,
employment regulations, and HR compliance requirements. Experience
managing payroll processes and working with payroll providers. Proven
experience conducting HR audits and implementing compliance
initiatives. Knowledge of occupational health and safety requirements
in Germany. Experience developing and maintaining HR policies and
procedures. Strong understanding of HRIS systems and HR data
management. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.
HSE certification preferred; candidates without formal qualifications
must demonstrate a willingness to complete HSE training Preferred
Qualifications Professional HR certification or relevant HR
qualification. Experience in an international or fast-growing
organization. Previous involvement in HR transformation, process
improvement, or digitalization projects. Experience working with audit
frameworks, compliance reviews, and risk management processes. Key
Competencies Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential
information. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to balance operational execution with strategic thinking.
Process-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
Strong project management and organisational skills. Collaborative and
customer-focused approach. What We Offer Opportunity to shape and
improve HR operations in a dynamic environment. Collaborative and
international team culture. Professional development and learning
opportunities. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Flexible
working arrangements. A people-first workplace focused on inclusion,
wellbeing, and growth. Equal Opportunity Statement We celebrate
diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for
all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all
backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and are dedicated to
ensuring equal opportunities throughout the

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking an
experienced Head of Academies (m/f/d) to provide operational
leadership for the European Raw Materials Academy and the European
Advanced Materials Academy. The European Raw Materials Academy and the
European Advanced Materials Academy are flagship European initiatives
that develop the skills and talent needed to strengthen Europe’s
competitiveness and industrial transformation in the raw and advanced
materials sectors. Reporting to the Director of Education & Skills,
the Head of Academies is responsible for translating strategic
priorities into operational delivery and ensuring the successful
implementation, scaling, and continuous improvement of both Academies.
The Head of Academies (m/f/d) provides direct line management to three
Senior Education Managers who collectively lead a multidisciplinary
team of approximately 20 colleagues. The ideal candidate combines
operational excellence with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proven
ability to scale digital education initiatives. Success will be
measured through learner growth, program quality, operational
performance, and delivery against agreed Academy KPIs. Key
Accountabilities The Head of Academies is accountable for: 1.
Operational Delivery • Translate strategic priorities into
operational plans and ensure successful delivery against agreed
objectives, KPIs, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and
compliance requirements. • Establish and maintain effective
operational processes, governance, reporting, and continuous
improvement across both Academies. 2. Education Portfolio & Digital
Learning Platforms • Lead the operational management and continuous
improvement of the Academies' digital learning ecosystem, providing
recommendations to support strategic decision-making. • Drive
learner growth, program quality, and an excellent learner experience
through effective operational management and data-informed
decision-making. 3. Team Leadership • Lead, coach, and support the
Senior Managers responsible for Operations, Course Development, and
Partnerships. • Foster a high-performing, collaborative, and
accountable multidisciplinary team. 4. Operational Performance &
Resources • Manage operational budgets within agreed frameworks,
supplier relationships, and procurement activities to support the
successful delivery of both Academies and ensure efficient and
compliant use of resources. • Develop, monitor, and report on
Academy KPIs, analyse operational performance, identify risks and
opportunities, and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. 5.
Stakeholder Collaboration • Maintain productive relationships with
internal teams and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment,
successful delivery, and sustainable growth of both Academies. What
We’re Looking For Required • Experience leading professional
learning, education, or workforce development programs. • Proven
success scaling digital education, EdTech, or professional learning
initiatives. • Operational leadership and program management
experience, including digital learning platforms and Learning
Management Systems. • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary
teams and delivering against ambitious KPIs and operational
objectives. • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder
management skills. • Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable
• Background in EdTech, professional education, or corporate
learning and development. • Experience building or scaling education
academies, digital learning platforms, or comparable education
initiatives. • Familiarity with EU-funded projects, Horizon Europe,
Erasmus+, or the EIT ecosystem. • Understanding of quality
assurance, certification, credentials, and micro-credentials. •
Working knowledge of additional European languages. What We Offer •
The opportunity to lead the operational scaling of two flagship
European Academies with significant strategic impact. • Join a
committed, mission-driven team working at the intersection of
education, innovation, industry, and European policy. • Work with
leading European universities, industry partners, and public-sector
organisations to help shape the future workforce for the raw and
advanced materials sectors. • Hybrid working environment in Berlin.
• Competitive salary. Position Details • Location: Berlin,
Germany. • Contract: Full-time. • Duration: Fixed-term contract
until 2029, with the possibility of extension. • Travel: Occasional
travel within Europe is required. • Reports to: Director of
Education & Skills, EIT RawMaterials. Commitment to Diversity: EIT
RawMaterials is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage
applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background.

ABOUT THE ROLEThis role owns ERC's development assurance processes: how requirements, architecture, validation and verification evidence are produced, traced and released across UAS, system, equipment, item and software level.
You define the framework and make it work on live programmes. Much of the job happens in conversation, so you will spend your time with the engineering teams rather than with documents alone. Your closest counterparts are our Configuration Manager, System Safety and the other teams who apply the process every day.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Own ERC's development assurance framework based on ARP4754B and DO-178C
• Write and maintain the Development Assurance, Validation, Verification and Process Assurance Plans
• Define which artefacts and maturity levels each gate requires, from Concept Design through to Entry Into Service
• Assign development assurance levels with System Safety and derive the independence requirements
• Build requirements and V&V workflows and keep traceability consistent across levels
• Sit with the IPTs to understand how engineers actually work before changing how they work
• Guide programmes through gate reviews and process audits, and close the findings

WHAT YOU BRING
• Deep, hands-on experience applying ARP4754A/B in aircraft or UAS development programmes
• Practical command of DO-178C and how software assurance connects to system level
• A track record of defining development processes, not only working within them
• Experience assigning development assurance levels and deriving process requirements from them
• Confident use of requirements management tooling for cross-level traceability
• No hesitation in walking up to people you have not met, asking how they work and getting them on board
• A technical degree in aerospace, mechanical or electrical engineering, and fluent English

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

About usclick here!Built for purpose.When time matters.ERC was founded to close Europe's critical capability gap in the sky. Two full-scale demonstrators. Two EU records. Built for the missions that cannot wait.

jobs.occupation: ISV Sales Specialist, Google Cloud (German, English) (Business-Development-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 8 years of technology related sales, business development, channel sales, or partner management experience.
- Ability to communicate in German and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience building business partnerships with enterprise Independent Software Vendors (ISV).
- Experience selling enterprise software solutions through Cloud Marketplaces.
- Experience working with, and managing, complex sales scenarios with multiple parties with differing goals.
- Experience creating new sales motions to scale best practices.
- Ability to work with customer engineers and customers' technical decision makers to secure a joint opportunity.

About the Job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As an ISV Sales Specialist, you will support the jointGo-To-Market (GTM) success of Independent Software Vendor (ISV) partners, including generating, advancing, and closing co-sell opportunities alongside the Google Cloud field sales team through the Google Cloud Marketplace.  You will work with ISV partners to create region-specific sales motions to increase awareness of the ISV within the Google Cloud field team, generate new leads, and accelerate active opportunities.  You will work with Google Cloud customers to support the evaluation, procurement, and usage of ISV partner solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €114000 - €116000 (EUR) + 66.67% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

- Build and grow relationships with existing ISV partners and customers by closing joint opportunities with Google cloud sales account teams and Google’s ecosystem.
- Develop regional co-sell plans and sales motions for ISV partners, working closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, customer engineers, and services teams.
- Drive sales plan achievement through ISV partner pipeline creation and reviews, ensuring sufficiency in pipeline creation, velocity, and win rate.
- Work with ISV partners, Google Cloud Sales teams, and customers to support transactions through the Google Cloud Marketplace, including distributor and reseller supported transactions.

jobs.description:
Specialist Investment Trading - Corporate Treasury Sales (f/m/d) Berlin

General information
Job ID 94299 Area Markets Products Start Date 01.07.2026 Contract Permanent Working Time Model Full-time Location(s) Berlin |

Corporate Treasury Sales partners with Germany’s leading corporates to navigate market risks with confidence - from  foreign exchange, interest rate and commodity solutions to securities and investment strategies. We combine sharp market expertise with the ability to design tailored OTC and investment products that truly move the needle for our clients. At CTS Germany, we bring this ambition to life through a high energy, team first culture: collaborative, curious, hands on and driven to deliver real impact. If you want to shape innovative Treasury solutions in a team that celebrates joint success, you will feel right at home with us.

What you can expect from us

- Advise corporate clients on investment and market risk solutions, securities, FX/MM and interest rate topics, with a clear commercial and closing-oriented focus.
- Drive the client risk management as well as investment business by identifying client needs, structuring tailored solutions, with main reponsibility for the full execution process.
- Develop and manage the client portfolio, taking responsibility for commercial results within your defined area.
- Closely monitor market developments to identify client opportunities and risk-related topics, driving initiatives forward with a strong execution mindset.
- Collaborate on business and sales strategies, bringing in your market insights and contributing to business unit-related strategy implementation.
- Unlock client potential and expand market share through proactive coverage, systematic follow-ups and high-quality advisory - while ensuring full regulatory compliance.
- Engage closely with internal partners to deliver comprehensive and tailored solutions for our clients.

What we expect from you

- Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, or a comparable field.
- Evidence of knowledge and experience according to § 87 Abs. 2 WpHG (2. FiMANoG) and §§ 1 & 6 WpHGMaAnzV.
- Proven sales expertise in investment and market risk solutions, securities, FX/MM and interest rate with the ability to advise clients and drive closings.
- Display a high level of commitment to proactive client outreach within the client portfolio to ensure best‑in‑class service and execution quality.
- Fluent German and English (spoken and written), with excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Very good understanding of business contexts.
- Show a keen interest in financial markets and up‑to‑date market movements.
- Thrive in a dynamic, fast‑moving environment.
- Good knowledge of accounting under HGB and IAS/IFRS.
- Familiarity with credit business, regulatory requirements (MiFID II, EMIR, Dodd Frank) and financial mathematics.
- Experience in foreign exchange and interest rate derivatives is a plus.
- High learning agility and an innovation and team-oriented mindset.

Design your work routine the way it suits you best: Whether it's in the office, remote within Germany, or abroad from another EU country. Looking to travel for longer? Take a sabbatical and explore the possibilities of New Work with us. • #EnjoyTheBest - As an employee, use the best premium account in Germany free of charge. • #CareNowForLater - We will continue to take care of you in the future. Because apart from monthly salary payments, retirement planning is a topic you should not wait until later to deal with. Therefore, we support your financial provision for retirement from day one. • #DontStopMoving - Enjoy the flexibility of Wellhub: Across Germany, you have access to a comprehensive network of sports, leisure, and wellness facilities. You also benefit from an international partner network that gives you access to offers around the globe. In this way, we support you in maintaining an active lifestyle while promoting environmentally friendly and cost‑efficient mobility. • #BalanceKidsAndCareer - We support you with childcare and are committed to helping you balance family and career. Whether through flexible working hours, financial allowances such as birth and maternity benefits, or a place in one of our daycare centers: With us, you combine children and career. • #EnjoyCulture - Art and culture are an expression of human existence. Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

You assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions

- 
You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives

- 
You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools

- 
You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility

- 
You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions

- 
You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices

-

- 
You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team members

Qualifikationen

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- 
You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field

- 
You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development

- 
You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)

Job Posting: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (m/f/d)
Transform the everyday.
This role is responsible for leading the global strategy, governance, and execution of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components across the entire supply chain. The individual ensures suppliers, manufacturing processes, quality standards, and material strategies are optimized for cost, quality, productivity, resilience, and sustainability while driving cross-functional collaboration between Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Quality teams worldwide.
In short, this is a senior global leadership position focused on improving supplier performance, product quality, operational efficiency, and supply chain effectiveness throughout the lifecycle of mechanical and mechatronic materials and components.

What we offer you

- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests
- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions
- Diverse health and wellness offerings
- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.

The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

How you will make an Impact with us

- You will be responsible for the global strategic direction of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components, including drawing-controlled parts, assemblies, manufacturing scopes, and supply chain investments.
- You will lead a team  (either directly or through collaboration models) and provide functional governance for local Material Lifecycle Management teams focused on mechatronics. You will ensure clear roles, standards, decision-making processes, and effective cross-site collaboration.
- You will develop and implement a global strategy for mechatronic parts, processes, and suppliers, focusing on standardization, technical feasibility, quality capability, supply chain resilience, sustainability, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and productivity.
- You will define supplier quality-related processes, methods, and standards for mechanical components and drive their global deployment, application, and continuous optimization across an international network.
- You will oversee preventive quality planning and industrialization readiness, particularly risk assessments, Process FMEA, Control Plans, Production Control Plans, First Article Inspection/PPAP, process audits, and release procedures for drawing-controlled purchased parts.
- You will establish a robust supplier problem management system with clear 8D governance, root cause analysis, effectiveness verification, lessons learned, claims management, and escalation procedures to sustainably reduce quality costs and recurring defects.
- You will further develop global and regional suppliers in collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Logistics, and other partners, focusing on process capability, performance, technological expertise, capacity, risk mitigation, and ESG requirements.
- You will drive transparency, digitalization, and data-based management through supplier quality KPIs, audit and action management, quality cost tracking, risk dashboards, and standardized management reporting.
- You will identify productivity opportunities throughout the material lifecycle, including standardization, product variant reduction, make-or-buy optimization, value stream and supply chain analysis, cost and process improvements, and robust relocation and localization strategies.
- You will represent Mechatronics Material Lifecycle Management in global decision-making committees and ensure strategic contributions are integrated early into development, sourcing, investment, and production decisions.

What you bring

Leadership & Governance

- You bring extensive long-term leadership experience in global, multicultural organizations, including both direct people leadership and cross-functional management across sites, functions, and hierarchical levels. You are capable of developing teams, clarifying responsibilities, setting priorities, and driving organizational change effectively.

Mechanical & Mechatronic Components

- You possess a strong understanding of mechanical and mechatronic materials, especially drawing-controlled parts, manufacturing processes, tolerances, inspection concepts, process capability, industrialization, engineering changes, capital investments, and global supply chain risks.

Strategy, Digitalization & Productivity

- You have experience in strategy development, process standardization, digital reporting, data-driven decision-making, productivity programs, and leading complex transformation or optimization initiatives within international manufacturing and supplier networks.

Methodological Expertise

- Knowledge of quality and continuous improvement tools is advantageous, including:
- Process FMEA
- PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)
- 8D Problem Solving
- Ishikawa (Fishbone) Analysis
- 5 Why Analysis
- Pareto Analysis
- Process Audits
- Corrective Action Management
- Lessons Learned Processes
- Control Plans
- KPI and Performance Reviews
- Structured Escalation Processes

Communication & Collaboration

- You are recognized for clear communication, diplomacy, negotiation skills, and the ability to align Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Suppliers toward common goals. Fluency in both German and English, along with willingness to travel globally to company sites and suppliers, completes your profile.

Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plus

jobs.occupation: Admissions & Programme Manager of Venture Support Programmes (m/f/d) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities Your Input You understand the challenges of healthcare venture building and are passionate about supporting early-stage entrepreneurs, innovators and researchers through education, mentoring, and capacity-building programmes. As Admissions & Programme Manager, you will manage participant admissions, support learners throughout the programme lifecycle, and help deliver an outstanding learning experience. In collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will also contribute to the design, implementation, quality assurance, and continuous improvement of our venture support programmes.
Responsibilities
• Manage the admissions process, assess applicants, and guide entrepreneurs and researchers to the most suitable venture support programmes and opportunities, such as venture-building programmes, bootcamps, Catapult initiatives, and scholarship opportunities.
• Lead programme implementation, including call launches, applicant engagement, stakeholder coordination, and project management throughout the programme development cycle.
• Support programme growth and operations by coordinating launches, optimizing existing programmes, managing invoices, preparing reports, and ensuring compliance with Horizon Europe funding requirements.
• You will also support the exploitation of the existing content in future implementations - based on lessons learned, market and clients' needs.
• Collaborate across the portfolio to ensure a smooth progression of participants between programmes, connecting innovators and entrepreneurs with the most relevant next-step opportunities, such as advanced venture support programmes and bootcamps.
• Coordinate pitching days and showcase events together with programme managers and the events team.

Your skills & knowledge What you bring
• Master’s degree or higher in health, science, business or entrepreneurship education studies or equivalent professional experience/qualifications.
• High level international project management skills, with a good understanding of the complexities involved in developing and delivering project outcomes; proven ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.
• Good understanding of the start-up journey in healthcare; ability to identify their opportunities for improvement and growth; experience in setting and managing standards of delivery to support the cost-effective and targeted delivery of activities and/or programmes.
• Sound knowledge of higher education programmes in Europe.
• Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills.
• Solution-oriented team player and comfortable working primarily remotely.
• Ability to work with an international team in a multidisciplinary context and to multi-task and manage a set of deliverables simultaneously.
• Languages: English fluent (spoken, written), other European languages an advantage.
• Experience in grant management, particularly European Grants (Erasmus+, Horizon 2020, EIT, Horizon Europe …) is a plus.
• Prior experience in entrepreneurship education and training is a plus.
• Occasional travel (2–4 times per year) may be required.

What we offer
• We are a 100% “Remote First” company, hiring in Germany, France, Spain and Poland.
• The possibility to join offices in various locations around Europe during business travel.
• 30 days of vacation & flexible working hours.
• Yearly bonus and our employee recognition programme.
• Straight forward internal communication, non-hierarchical structure, and freedom to operate with autonomy.
• A large and vibrant network in the healthcare sector, with exposure to high-level and senior rep-resentatives from key players and influencers.
• The opportunity to work on critical projects of European interest, contributing to improving the lives of citizens and patients.

Application process
• EIT Health applies a policy of equal opportunities and accepts applications without discrimination on any grounds.
• Applications should consist of a cover letter and a full curriculum vitae.
• Please include the following in the cover letter: introduction, your motivations for applying for the position, your earliest start date, and your salary expectations.
• Applications via our careers page only.
• Applications will be reviewed on the rolling basis until the right candidate is identified. The position is to be filled as soon as possible.

About usEIT Health is one of Europe’s largest and most dynamic health innovation communities, dedicated to improving the lives of citizens and patients and strengthening healthcare systems across the continent.
Our mission is simple: to drive healthcare innovation and create positive societal impact across Europe. In a landscape marked by an ageing population, rising chronic disease, workforce shortages, and increasing pressure on healthcare budgets, our community serves as a catalyst, enabling creative thinking, cross-border collaboration, and evidence-based solutions that deliver real-world impact.
As a Knowledge and Innovation Community (KIC) of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), our pan-European network brings together over 80 members, exceptional in the worlds of business, education, research and health service delivery, alongside thousands of start-ups, entrepreneurs and healthcare professionals. By combining their collective expertise we help new solutions reach the people and services that need them most.
For more information please visit our website: www.eithealth.eu

kiutraDo you want to shape the future as part of a diverse, international team in a fast-growing, deep-tech company? Then read on! At kiutra, we contribute to the development and application of quantum technologies by offering innovative and sustainable cooling solutions based on our unique magnetic cooling technology.

To strengthen our team, we're looking for a Chief of Staff (f/m/d) who's ready to work closely with our Managing Director. You dig into topics, get the right people talking, and and stay on top of open items. In this role you bring solid know-how in corporate law, compliance, financing, and accounting to the materials, proposals, and advisor conversations you help shape. You run with things independently and need little guidance.
Responsibilities
• You prepare decisions for the Managing Director, working through the facts, laying out options, and producing materials and resolution proposals.
• You support processes owned by functional departments or external advisors, preparing the Managing Director's input, consolidating information, and organizing alignment.
• You coordinate participants, deadlines, and work status across departments, advisors, and countries.
• You follow up on open items and deadlines, flagging early when topics stall or drift apart.
• You take care of documentation and record keeping minutes, resolutions, deadline overviews, and tracking of commitments made.
• You independently handle clearly defined work packages on behalf of the Managing Director, working with a high degree of autonomy.

Requirements
• You hold a completed university degree in law, business, natural sciences, or comparable; a legal background is an advantage given the governance topics involved.
• You bring 3 to 6 years in management consulting, investment banking, a commercial law firm, audit, or a comparable role in a growing technology company.
• You have hands-on experience handling commercial, corporate law, or regulatory matters.
• You solve problems in a structured and analytical way.
• You coordinate and keep track across several topics, including reliable follow-up on open items until completion.
• You're confident with numbers: budget, forecast, fundamentals of financial accounting, and you're willing to get to grips with corporate law and tax questions.
• You have full professional proficiency in both German and English (written and spoken).
• You prepare complex matters precisely and concisely for the respective audience.
• You handle confidential shareholder, compensation, and transaction information with the utmost discretion and integrity.
• You stay calm and adaptable when priorities shift or things are unclear.
• You're ready to align your pace with the Managing Director's including occasional travel as needed.
• You're interested in deep tech and hardware; prior technical knowledge is not required.

Benefits
• You will enjoy flexibility with options for remote work and flexible working hours.
• You will experience an open-minded, appreciative startup atmosphere with flat hierarchies and an open-door policy.
• You will work with a great team in a fast-growing deep-tech company.
• You can expect regular performance reviews and long-term job prospects.
• You can look forward to 30 vacation days per year.
• You will have the chance to participate in valuable employee surveys.
• You will work in a comfortable, bright and modern office with ergonomic equipment in compliance with health requirements.
• You can benefit from “The Coolest Connection”, our employee referral program.
• You will have the opportunity to get to know your team members better at our teambuilding events, Christmas parties, and other group events.
• You will have free cold and hot drinks, snacks, and fruit at your disposal.
• You can benefit from our company's pension plan, our bicycle leasing program (Jobrad), and contribution for the Deutschland-Ticket Jobticket.

Interested? Then send us your application now! To find out more about us, please visit https://kiutra.com/

jobs.occupation: Internship in Avionics Systems - Database Architecture (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Internship in Avionics Systems - Database Architecture

Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of Avionics Systems - Database Architecture? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in Database Architecture and Roadmap as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Immenstaad/Friedrichshafen
- Start: 01.04.2027 with some flexibility
- Duration: 4-6 months

This internship provides the opportunity to work on cutting edge space programmes, for customers such as the European Space Agency, within the Avionics Systems organization of Airbus Space Systems. This technical role will involve working in the area of development, test and delivery of state-of-the-art data processes and solutions for spacecraft engineering.

Avionics Systems is an organisation within Airbus Space Systems that builds the functional part of a spacecraft. This includes defining the operational concept, developing and validating on-board software, and developing a simulator of the spacecraft, among many other things. One of the central elements of our spacecraft is the System Reference Database (SRDB) that contains a digital representation of the Avionics architecture, and serves as the central engineering and data hub for the Avionics design.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Friedrichshafen you will be working on innovation where others spend their holidays. Enjoy panoramic views of Lake Constance while having lunch in our canteen. And after work, join one of our many corporate sports groups to go running, sailing or skiing.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Traveling within Europe and/or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Isolating and resolving issues in the Avionics design of a space vehicle
- Importing or manually injecting new data into the SRDB
- Extracting or querying a subset of data of the Avionics design of a space vehicle
- Ensuring data consistency via queries and scripts
- Developing new or adapting existing scripts
- Testing and validating new database technologies and products
- Other supportive work on ongoing programs and projects

Desired skills and qualifications

- Fluent in English.
- enrolled fulltime student (d/f/m) in Aerospace or astronautical engineering with an interest for and first experience in model-based (systems) engineering OR informatics with a strong interest in data management and engineering of space vehicles
- An interest in building systems
- A strong interest in developing yourself
- The ability to find creative solutions to complex problems
- The ability to explore and elaborate new subjects on your own

Please upload the following documents**: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.**

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (http://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
